name: driveos-desktop
description: DriveOS Agent — desktop tray app for non-technical editors
author: DriveOS

scripts.build:agent: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix ../agent run bundle
scripts.build: npm run build:agent && npm run build:main
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never && npm run verify:release
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never && npm run verify:release
